demos.title: Accessible lab safety video
demos.description: Video stimulus with a poster, English captions, a plain-text transcript, and resolved accessibility declarations.

transcript.plainText: Step one. Put on safety goggles before handling laboratory materials. Step two. Use heat-resistant gloves when touching a heated container. Step three. Place the container on a heat-safe surface, away from paper.

media.label: Lab safety demonstration
media.description: Watch how the student prepares to handle a heated container safely.
